items.name: arc-diagram
items.title: Arc diagram
items.description: Places entities in order on a line and joins each related pair with a semicircular arc whose thickness is the value of the connection; dots are sized by each entity's total.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Shows a quantity over time as a filled area from zero: one series, stacked series, shares of 100%, or a streamgraph.

items.name: arrow-chart
items.title: Arrow chart
items.description: Draws an arrow per category from a start value to an end value, showing the direction and size of each shift.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Compares a value across categories with bars from a zero baseline.

items.name: beeswarm-chart
items.title: Beeswarm chart
items.description: Shows a distribution as one dot per row along a value axis, with dots stacked sideways where they would collide.

items.name: big-number
items.title: Big number
items.description: A featured statistic with its label, change and the context that gives it meaning.

items.name: block-bar
items.title: Block bars
items.description: Compares 3 to 12 values as thick rounded bars from a zero baseline, with each value printed inside the end of its bar and the category beneath.

items.name: box-plot
items.title: Box plot
items.description: Summarises a numeric field per group as median, quartile box, whiskers and outlier dots, computed from raw rows.

items.name: bubble-network
items.title: Bubble network
items.description: Draws a small set of circles sized by value and joined by thin lines, with one circle highlighted and tagged.

items.name: bubble-scale
items.title: Bubble scale
items.description: Places circles sized by one measure along a single value scale set by another, spread sideways so none overlap, with boxed scale marks instead of an axis.

items.name: bullet-chart
items.title: Bullet chart
items.description: Compares one measure per row with its target, optionally against qualitative bands such as poor / fair / good.

items.name: bump-chart
items.title: Bump chart
items.description: Shows how the ranking of entities changes over time, with rank 1 at the top and each line named at its end.

items.name: calendar-heatmap
items.title: Calendar heatmap
items.description: Colours every day of one or more years by a value, laid out as a grid of weeks.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: A boxed statement of fact with a short bold lead and a sentence of explanation. The tone is marked by icon and tint.

items.name: choropleth-map
items.title: Choropleth map
items.description: Colours the regions of a map by a normalised value, from GeoJSON you supply.

items.name: circle-pack
items.title: Circle pack
items.description: Shows parts as tightly packed circles sized by value, optionally clustered into groups, with the value and name printed inside each circle.

items.name: curve-rank
items.title: Curve rank
items.description: Places each entity on two parallel scales, one per measure, and joins its two positions with a smooth S-curve labelled with the name and both values.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A restrained editorial table from rows and a column config: aligned tabular numbers, an optional in-cell bar, row highlight and click-to-sort headers.

items.name: delta
items.title: Delta
items.description: An inline change indicator: direction arrow, signed value and an optional baseline label.

items.name: diverging-bar-chart
items.title: Diverging bar chart
items.description: Draws bars either side of a centre line: positive against negative values, or stacked agree / disagree responses around a neutral midpoint.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Shows how 2 to 5 parts make up one whole, with each slice labelled by name and share.

items.name: dumbbell-chart
items.title: Dumbbell chart
items.description: Shows two values per category as dots joined by a line, so the length of the line shows the difference.

items.name: fan-flow
items.title: Fan flow
items.description: One solid block that splits into curved ribbons, each as thick as its value, ending at an aligned column of names, values and shares.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: Shows how many remain at each step of a sequence, with conversion and drop-off between steps.

items.name: glyph-table
items.title: Glyph table
items.description: A table with one row per entity in which every number is drawn as a small form chosen per column (counted dots, squares or icons, a ring, a sized circle, a bar) with the value printed beside it.

items.name: headline
items.title: Headline
items.description: The opening block of a piece or section: kicker, title, one-sentence deck and a byline/date line.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Colours a category-by-category (or time-by-category) grid by a numeric value, using a sequential or diverging scale.

items.name: histogram
items.title: Histogram
items.description: Bins a numeric field and shows how many rows fall in each bin, as touching bars on a continuous axis.

items.name: icon-array-grid
items.title: Icon array grid
items.description: Compares many counts as a grid of labelled tiles, each holding an array of N icons with its name and number.

items.name: icon-stat
items.title: Icon stat
items.description: A "1 in 4"-style statement: a row or grid of simple glyphs with some filled, and the sentence they illustrate.

items.name: legend-key
items.title: Legend key
items.description: A standalone colour key: categorical swatches, or a sequential/diverging ramp with end labels.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Shows how one or more values change over time or another ordered dimension.

items.name: lollipop-chart
items.title: Lollipop chart
items.description: Ranks categories with a dot on a thin stem from zero, or as a stemless dot plot on a free scale.

items.name: nested-shares
items.title: Nested shares
items.description: Shows several shares of the same whole, such as one share at five dates, as outlines nested from one corner of a square, each enclosing an area equal to its share.

items.name: orbit-chart
items.title: Orbit chart
items.description: Places items as dots on concentric rings round a centre, one ring per category, level or period, with a key that explains rings, angle and dot area.

items.name: pictogram-chart
items.title: Pictogram chart
items.description: Compares quantities with rows of repeated icons, each icon standing for a fixed number of units.

items.name: pill-rank
items.title: Pill rank
items.description: Shows a ranked list as horizontally centred rounded bars, with each name in capitals on its pill, the value at the left edge and the rank at the right.

items.name: progress-meter
items.title: Progress meter
items.description: A labelled horizontal meter of one value against a maximum or target, with the target marked and the value printed.

items.name: proportional-area
items.title: Proportional area
items.description: Compares two to eight values as squares or circles whose areas are proportional to the values, each printed with its name and number.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: A readable block of narration at a 45-75 character measure, for the text between charts.

items.name: pull-quote
items.title: Pull quote
items.description: A large quotation with its attribution.

items.name: radial-bar-chart
items.title: Radial bar chart
items.description: Draws bars around a circle for data that repeats in a cycle, such as hours of the day or months of the year.

items.name: radial-spokes
items.title: Radial spokes
items.description: Draws one spoke per row radiating from a centre disc, each as long as its value, with the name and value set on an outer ring.

items.name: ribbon-chart
items.title: Ribbon chart
items.description: One filled band per entity across periods: its thickness is its value in each period and its vertical position is its rank, so bands cross as the order changes.

items.name: sankey-chart
items.title: Sankey chart
items.description: Shows how a quantity flows from sources through stages to destinations, with link width proportional to the flow.

items.name: scale-ladder
items.title: Scale ladder
items.description: A tall vertical band graded along one scale (linear or log, running up or down) with each item placed at its true position and labelled with an icon, its name and its value on alternating sides.

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter chart
items.description: Plots two numeric measures against each other, one dot per row, with optional bubble size, group colour, selective labels and a trend line.

items.name: segmented-bar
items.title: Segmented bar
items.description: Splits one whole into proportional segments along a single horizontal bar.

items.name: shape-fill
items.title: Shape fill
items.description: Shows one or more percentages as icon silhouettes filled from the bottom to that level, with the number printed large beside each.

items.name: slope-chart
items.title: Slope chart
items.description: Connects each entity's value at two (or a few) points with a straight line, labelled with name and value at both ends.

items.name: small-multiples
items.title: Small multiples
items.description: Repeats one small line, area or bar chart per value of a facet field on a shared scale, each panel titled.

items.name: source-note
items.title: Source note
items.description: A sourcing footer for a whole piece: sources with optional links, the period covered, method, caveats and credit.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A word-sized line or bar series without axes, with the latest point marked.

items.name: stat-circles
items.title: Stat circles
items.description: Shows a few related magnitudes as plain circles sized by area, each with its number set large and a short label.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat tile
items.description: A compact, bordered KPI tile: label, value, change against a baseline and an optional trend graphic.

items.name: step-marker
items.title: Step marker
items.description: A numbered chapter or step heading ("01 — Electricity sources in 2015") for sequencing the sections of a story.

items.name: strip-plot
items.title: Strip plot
items.description: Shows every observation as a tick or dot along a value axis, one row per category.

items.name: timeline-chart
items.title: Timeline chart
items.description: Places events and spans on a time axis in labelled lanes, with each item named directly.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Shows parts of a whole as nested rectangles sized by value, optionally grouped into categories.

items.name: unit-blocks
items.title: Unit blocks
items.description: Shows the size of each group as a solid block of small icons, one icon per fixed number of units.

items.name: waffle-chart
items.title: Waffle chart
items.description: Shows shares of a whole as counted cells in a grid, such as 37 in every 100.

items.name: annotated-timeline
items.title: Annotated timeline
items.description: A vertical sequence of dated events along a rail, each with a short explanation and, optionally, a small chart or figure.

items.name: before-after
items.title: Before and after
items.description: Two states of one measure side by side, as figures or small charts, with the change between them stated in the middle.

items.name: chart-callout
items.title: Chart with callout
items.description: A chart with a callout beside it that states the main fact. In narrow containers the callout goes underneath.

items.name: chart-tabs
items.title: Chart tabs
items.description: One chart frame with a segmented control that switches between several views of the same data, morphing between views that share a chart type.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: A table whose rows carry inline sparklines, deltas and in-cell bars beside their exact values, from rows and a column config.

items.name: filter-chips
items.title: Filter chips
items.description: The active crossfilter selections of the surrounding `InsightData`, shown as removable chips with a reset control.

items.name: hero-figure
items.title: Hero figure
items.description: The opening exhibit of a piece: kicker, headline and deck above one large chart, with a source line underneath.

items.name: kpi-grid
items.title: KPI grid
items.description: A responsive grid of trend cards drawn from one dataset: each metric shows its latest value, its change and a sparkline.

items.name: linked-charts
items.title: Linked charts
items.description: Two to four charts over one shared dataset in a responsive grid: clicking a mark in one filters the others, with the active filters shown as removable chips.

items.name: metric-breakdown
items.title: Metric breakdown
items.description: A headline number with its composition underneath: one segmented bar and a key giving each part's value and share.

items.name: poster
items.title: Poster
items.description: The sheet an infographic is composed on. It paints a full-bleed ground from a poster theme, forces one theme and colour mode on everything inside, and lays out a masthead, a grid of panels and a footer. It can save the whole sheet as one PNG.

items.name: proportion-statement
items.title: Proportion statement
items.description: A share stated as a countable sentence ("37 in every 100…"): a waffle grid or a row of icons beside the statement in large type, with the number emphasised.

items.name: quote-figure
items.title: Quote with figure
items.description: A pull-quote paired with the statistic or small chart that backs it up, side by side and stacking in narrow containers.

items.name: ranked-list
items.title: Ranked list
items.description: A ranking as a list: position, name, value and a thin in-row bar, with an optional change indicator and highlighted rows.

items.name: scrolly-chart
items.title: Scrolly chart
items.description: A scroll-driven story from JSON: one base chart spec and a list of steps, each with narration and a patch of chart props applied while that step is active.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A story section: a numbered step marker or a headline, introductory prose, then one or more exhibits in a responsive one- to three-column grid.

items.name: small-multiple-grid
items.title: Small multiple grid
items.description: Repeats any chart spec once per value of a facet field, each panel with its own filtered rows and a title, in a grid that follows the container width.

items.name: stat-row
items.title: Stat row
items.description: Two to five key figures in one row separated by hairlines, collapsing to two columns and then one as the container narrows.

items.name: trend-card
items.title: Trend card
items.description: A KPI card computed from a series: the latest value, its change against a baseline in the same data, and a sparkline of the series.

items.name: atlas-poster
items.title: Atlas poster
items.description: A landscape spread of up to eleven small illustrations of one subject, each a different graphic form, in three bands of unequal panels: a statement in large type, spokes round an icon and a network of circles; a smooth trend with its peak labelled, nested squares and a slope chart; a pill ranking, a treemap, a tile map and sized circles; and a closing row of icon statements.

items.name: comparison-brief
items.title: Comparison brief
items.description: A compared with B on one page. It has a headline that states the result, the headline figures mirrored either side of their labels, one hero exhibit that shows both sides, paired exhibits on a shared scale, a verdict callout and a source note.

items.name: count-poster
items.title: Count poster
items.description: A poster that counts at scale. Blocks of thousands of unit icons fill most of the sheet, a second band counts reference groups with the same icon at the same size in a muted colour, and a bottom row holds three small graphics: squares sized by area with a ratio bracket, thick bars with the numbers inside, and shares as nested outlines or filled silhouettes.

items.name: data-explorer
items.title: Data explorer
items.description: A set of linked charts over one shared dataset that filter each other. It has a headline, a sentence of instructions with filter chips, a row of figures that recompute from the filtered rows, two to four charts and an optional detail table. It opens on selections the author chooses.

items.name: executive-brief
items.title: Executive brief
items.description: A one-page summary. It has a headline that states the main finding with its number, a deck, a row of three or four key figures, one hero chart with a takeaway callout, two smaller supporting exhibits, a short list of actions and a source note.

items.name: explainer
items.title: Explainer
items.description: A vertical infographic in one narrow column. It opens with a big number or a proportion statement (`hook`), then the hero exhibit, then numbered sections with one exhibit each, a conclusion with an optional link, and sources.

items.name: flow-poster
items.title: Flow poster
items.description: A portrait poster of where something comes from and where it goes, in three stacked bands painted in one colour: the producers as large labelled tiles, the leading producer's output fanning out as ribbons to an aligned column of destinations, and the destinations as bubbles on a scale of how much each depends on that producer.

items.name: matrix-poster
items.title: Matrix poster
items.description: One wide landscape graphic that compares 4 to 12 entities on five to seven measures: two measures as S-curves between parallel scales on the left, joined to a table on the right in which every other number is drawn as dots, squares, icons, a ring, a circle or a bar. Both halves share one row order and one colour per entity.

items.name: network-poster
items.title: Network poster
items.description: A poster of who is connected to whom: a full-width arc diagram with one arc per connection, as thick as its value (`arc-diagram`), a strip of two to four large figures, and a bottom row where the same entities return as circles joined by lines (`bubble-network`) and as a ranking of centred pills (`pill-rank`).

items.name: profile-poster
items.title: Profile poster
items.description: A poster that describes one subject from four sides: the subject as one large silhouette filled to a share (`shape-fill`), two to four large figures, its place among other things on one scale (`scale-ladder`), and a table that sets it beside its peers with every number drawn as a small form (`glyph-table`).

items.name: radial-poster
items.title: Radial poster
items.description: A poster with one subject in the middle of the sheet: a wheel of spokes round an icon (`radial-spokes`), two to four large figures standing either side of it, and a bottom row with the same subject's surroundings on concentric rings (`orbit-chart`) and a ranking as centred pills (`pill-rank`).

items.name: ranking-poster
items.title: Ranking poster
items.description: A poster of one subject by the numbers, in four rows: two figures in large type or as filled silhouettes, two treemaps side by side, a full-width ranking of centred pills with one row highlighted, and packed circles with icons beside a column of sized circles and a closing figure.

items.name: report-page
items.title: Report page
items.description: A section of an analytical report laid out as a document. It has a title block, a summary, numbered findings, then method, limitations and sources. Each finding has one exhibit, an observation and a separately labelled interpretation with a confidence rating and a caveat.

items.name: scale-poster
items.title: Scale poster
items.description: A tall poster that is one illustrated scale: a full-height `scale-ladder` with icons, leader-labelled items and named zones, and a narrow side column of large figures and one small graphic, each set level with the part of the scale it describes.

items.name: scorecard
items.title: Scorecard
items.description: A recurring report. It has a masthead with the report name and period, a headline that states the main change, a KPI grid with changes and sparklines, a ranked list beside one or two trend charts, an optional comparison table, short notes and a source note.

items.name: social-card
items.title: Social card
items.description: A graphic that states one fact, at a fixed aspect ratio (1:1, 4:5, 16:9 or 9:16). It has a kicker, a headline, one exhibit, a source and a credit, painted on the theme surface. A button downloads the whole card as a PNG.

items.name: story-deck
items.title: Story deck
items.description: A sequence of full-frame cards (title, stat, chart, quote, closing) that the reader swipes or steps through. Each card states one fact. It has an optional fixed aspect ratio, a keyboard-accessible pager and a stacked layout for print.

items.name: timeline-poster
items.title: Timeline poster
items.description: A poster of change over a run of periods: a full-width ribbon of bands whose thickness is each entity's value and whose order is its rank (`ribbon-chart`), a strip of two to four dated figures under it, and a bottom row with one measure per period as thick bars (`block-bar`) and one share at several dates as nested outlines (`nested-shares`).

items.name: timeline-story
items.title: Timeline story
items.description: A story told in date order. It has a headline, one overview exhibit of the whole period (a timeline chart or an annotated line), dated chapters along a rail, a closing paragraph and a source note. Each chapter has a short text and an optional small exhibit.

items.name: visual-essay
items.title: Visual essay
items.description: A long article read by scrolling. It has a headline, then an ordered list of blocks in a reading column, then a source note. The blocks are prose, figures, charts with a callout, scrolly sequences, pull quotes, stat rows, small multiples and chapter breaks. Exhibits can be wider than the column.

items.name: theme
items.title: InsightCharts theme variables
items.description: Adds the --ic-* CSS variables (light and dark) to your stylesheet so charts can be restyled from CSS. The values are the library defaults; edit them to re-skin.
items.docs: Edit the --ic-* variables in your global CSS. Guide: https://insightcharts.dev/llms/guides/theming.md

items.name: insight
items.title: Insight spec renderer
items.description: Renders any InsightCharts component from a JSON spec ({ type, ...props }), with a place to register customised local copies.
